semanticRules: Order existence, financial ledger and payments are independently sourced and reconciled.
Keep eligible untracked orders and renewals; neither missing session nor missing customer erases store sales.
AOV uses frozen purchase_merchandise_net_usd, not later ledger net divided by purchase-day order counts.
Post-purchase order edits require an approved movement/correction policy; never silently rewrite the purchase snapshot.
Checkout linkage is not acquisition attribution; require consent, ownership and corroborated server context.
Preserve source_currency even for quarantined/non-USD orders; USD metrics fail their complete scope rather than silently omitting them.
publicationGates: Idempotent order upsert; unique order_id per publication; reconcile source counts and purchase-time totals.
Eligible orders have paid_at, purchase_date and approved eligibility evidence.
matched checkout status requires a resolvable session and safe evidence; conflicting links stay null.
Purchase-time net equals gross minus merchandise discounts; independently sum order_items before comparison.
openDecisions: Approve paid_at semantics, excluded/canceled/part-paid orders, purchases subsequently refunded, edits and renewal eligibility.
Approve how historical purchase-time snapshots are reconstructed when only current order state is available.

semanticRules: Exclusive components: gross does not already net discounts; merchandise_refund is the actual post-discount merchandise reversal, not the gross returned price plus another discount reversal.
Split a gross customer refund into merchandise, shipping, tax and duties once using source evidence; never also count its all-in refund total as merchandise_refund.
If an original component is corrected/reversed, retain a signed correction in the same component and do not also classify it as a second economic refund.

Net merchandise = merchandise_gross + merchandise_discount + merchandise_refund. Proposed total sales additionally includes shipping_net + tax_net + duty_net + approved other_sales_adjustment; excludes fee, gift-card liability issuance and payments.
Product refund reporting uses merchandise_refund effective date and validated order_item_id only; a payment refund or order-level allocation guess is not product refund evidence.
Do not sum both a source movement total and its allocations. Components must reconcile to each source movement before publication.
Unallocated merchandise remains in store totals but blocks a fully reconciled SKU view; an explicit unallocated diagnostic row is not a guessed SKU.
publicationGates: Unique ledger_entry_id; allocation totals reconcile source_movement_id.
Required order references resolve; non-null item reference belongs to the same order.
Component sign/reversal tests, source refund split, currency, dates and count reconciliation pass.
A product metric requires complete merchandise line allocation over its requested date/scope, including later refunds.
openDecisions: Approve total-sales component policy, adjustment recognition and gift card/tip treatment.
Confirm refund components and historical line allocations available in source; choose withholding vs explicitly partial diagnostic product reporting.

semanticRules: Select exactly one model and publication; there must be one attribution row for every eligible order, including renewal/not_applicable rows.
Proposed last eligible non-direct session in [paid_at - 30 days, paid_at]; no after-conversion touches.
First-order customer credit is taken only from attribution for customers.first_eligible_order_id, not every later order.
For single-touch v1 weighted new customers count each certified first customer once at weight 1; unassigned buckets remain visible.
ROAS uses purchase-time net merchandise value on conversion_date, not later-refund ledger net or acquisition-session entry date.
Other date/revenue bases need a separately approved metric/model; native platform ROAS is not reproduced.
Renewals retain commerce revenue; acquisition applicability and not_applicable assignment follow approved order-class policy.
publicationGates: Exactly one row per eligible order/model/publication; weights sum to one including unassigned rows.
Session identity evidence permitted and in approved lookback; optional touch belongs to that session.
Campaign/channel mapping and independently expected spend comparison scope pass.
Unattributed share and pending coverage disclosed; null/missing touch cannot become an organic classification.
openDecisions: Approve model, 30-day boundaries, paid_at conversion clock, fallback for direct-only traffic, renewal classes and ingestion grace.
Approve purchase-value first-party ROAS definition; a refund-adjusted ledger variant is not in lean v1.

semanticRules: Rows encode membership only. No allocation_weight or exclusive sales ownership is implemented.
Filter a distinct order_item_id set using an EXISTS/semijoin, then aggregate line ledger values once.
One line may contribute to each separate offer slice; do not sum slices to a store total.
Observed event offer_id is context, not proof of purchased offer membership.
publicationGates: Unique membership key and resolvable line; reproducible approved evidence.
Offer-filtered totals reconcile distinct selected line set; stacked offers do not multiply values.
openDecisions: Approve offer taxonomy and membership evidence; exclusive allocation requires a separate versioned weights contract and approval.
